title: 80s Catalog Studies
description: Nine independent 80s computer catalog page studies — each page tests a different corner of early desktop-publishing print (rainbow stripe headers, dot-matrix headlines, isometric wireframes, dense monospace body, order forms) at modern scan fidelity.
creative_direction: Each image is a 1:1 catalog page crop for a different module (workstation cover, printer page, network diagram, software grid, accessories grid, support plan table, keyboard schematic, monitor specs, order form). Shared palette: tech-blue plus beige plus neutral gray plus rainbow stripe highlights. Shared treatments: punch-hole margin, rainbow stripe header bar, dot-matrix headline, isometric wireframe drawings, dense monospace body copy, cold fluorescent office mood.
